top_band: yellow/tan reed mat with blue fish and wooden frame from row 1 to row 17
evidence: The rack shows a clear foreshortened horizontal top surface (rows 1-17) with a wooden frame, woven mat, and five drying fish, followed by a lighter front edge at row 17, darker front apron face at rows 18-20, and four supporting legs (back legs recessed at rows 21-22, front legs extending to row 24).

style.evidence: The piece uses 5-6 distinct shading tones across the woven mat, wood frame, and fish, with dark brown material outlines rather than pure black. The vertical striping/shading on the mat and detailed little fish give it rich texture and tile density comparable to the Beodeul reference stall.
